# Better Homes & Gardens

> > Better Homes & Gardens (BHG) is a trusted lifestyle publication offering expert advice on home decorating, gardening, cooking, and product recommendations.

Founded as a comprehensive resource for homeowners, BHG provides tested product reviews, design inspiration, plant care guides, and seasonal recipes. The site features contributions from experts like Mary Cornetta (Organized Overall) and Karla Walsh, along with celebrity collaborations and trending lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design & Home Decor
- Gardening & Plant Care
- Product Reviews & Recommendations
- Cleaning Tips & Organization
- Recipe Testing & Cooking
- Home Improvement Projects
- Amazon Deals & Shopping
- Midcentury Modern Style
- Annual Flowers & Perennials
- Real Estate & Curb Appeal
- Seasonal Decorating
- Expert Contributors (Mary Cornetta, Karla Walsh)
- Celebrity Partnerships (Drew Barrymore, Ina Garten)
- Garden Tools & Equipment

## Home Design & Decorating

- [20 Midcentury Modern Decor Ideas for the Retro Flair You Want](https://www.bhg.com/decorating/decorating-style/midcentury-modern): Midcentury modern decorating ideas and retro style tips
- [Why Open Concept Is Losing Favor to the Return of Separate Rooms](https://www.bhg.com/decline-of-open-concept-11917820): Home design trend shift from open-concept to defined room layouts
- [20 Basement Ideas](https://www.bhg.com/finished-basement-ideas-8425735): Basement finishing and renovation design inspiration gallery
- [6 Winter Flower Arrangements You Can Make with Store-Bought Blooms](https://www.bhg.com/decorating/home-accessories/flower-arranging/winter-flower-arrangements): DIY winter flower arrangements using grocery store bouquets
- [6 Popular Curb Appeal Trends That Could Lower Your Home's Value](https://www.bhg.com/curb-appeal-trends-that-lower-homes-value-11922504): Real estate expert advice on curb appeal trends to avoid when selling

## Gardening & Plant Care

- [The 5 Best Plant Moisture Meters Our Editors Recommend](https://www.bhg.com/best-plant-moisture-meters-7976267): Expert-tested plant moisture meters for houseplants and gardens
- [Do Petunias Attract Hummingbirds? Here's What an Expert Says](https://www.bhg.com/do-petunias-attract-hummingbirds-11733452): Expert Jenny Rose Carey on using petunias to attract hummingbirds
- [Is It Better to Buy Plants from a Garden Center or Online?](https://www.bhg.com/buying-plants-online-vs-garden-center-11734111): Expert comparison of local nurseries vs online plant retailers
